items.title: First annual premium collected by direct debit
items.quote: Den ersten Jahresbeitrag ziehen wir zum Versicherungsbeginn per Lastschrift ein.
items.computation: The policy states Versicherungsbeginn = 01.02.2027, 0:00 Uhr, and that the first annual premium is debited on this start date. No other start date is given, so the direct debit falls due on 01.02.2027.

warnings: The policy term runs 'Versicherungsbeginn 01.02.2027' for '1 Jahr', so under §§ 187 Abs. 2, 188 Abs. 2 BGB the first insurance year ends 31.01.2028; the cancellation deadline (three months before that, per the printed renewal clause) is 31.10.2027 and, as a notice period, is not shifted even if it falls on a weekend or holiday.
This is a standard policy confirmation with no decision subject to objection, so no legal-remedy (Rechtsbehelfsbelehrung) section is expected or present.
